test_title: RRB Group D Previous Year Paper (Held on: 27 Sept 2022 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: Which Indian state is the host of the FIH Hockey Men's World Cup 2023?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Odisha**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Odisha will host the 2023 Men's Hockey World Cup from the 13th to the 29th of January 2023.__
 
• For the first time, a country with the same city would be hosting successive editions of the premier tournament in the sport making it even more special.
 
• This time, Bhubaneswar which hosted the 2018 WC would share hosting rights with the Biju Patnaik Hockey Stadium in Rourkela.​

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

__
 
• India__ will host the 2023 Men's Hockey World Cup from 13th to 29th of January 2023.
 
• India will now host this tournament for the __fourth time in history__.
 
• The world cup is conducted once every __four years__.
 
• Tournaments associated with hockey are Rene Frank Trophy, Essande Champions Cup, Agha Khan cup, Beighton Cup, Bombay Gold Cup, Dhyan Chand Trophy, Gurmeet Trophy, Gura Nanak Cup, Indira Gold Cup, Sahni Trophy, Tommy Eman Gold Cup, Ranjit Singh Gold Cup, Scindia Gold Cup, Gyanuati Devi Trophy.
 
• Spain and the Netherlands have been named as the co-hosts of the 2022 Women's World Cup scheduled to be held from 1st to 22nd of July 2022.
 
• The decisions were made during FIH's Executive Board Meeting in Lausanne, Switzerland on 9 Nov 2019.
